deck.title: AWS Organizations & Control Tower
deck.analogy: Organizations is an office building: the management account is the owner, OUs are floors, accounts are offices, and SCPs are building rules every office must obey.

cards.front: What is the AWS Organizations structure?

back.answer: One management account at the top; member accounts hang off a tree: Root → OUs → accounts.
back.explanation: Accounts are the strongest isolation boundary AWS offers, so companies run dozens of them.
back.mnemonic: Office building: owner = management account, floors = OUs, offices = accounts.

cards.front: In AWS Organizations, what are SCPs in the building analogy?

back.answer: Building rules posted by the owner on a floor that every office must obey regardless of its own policy.
back.explanation: SCPs apply down the tree no matter what the member account's own IAM policies say.
back.mnemonic: SCPs = building rules on a floor.

cards.front: What does AWS Organizations consolidated billing provide?

back.answer: One bill paid by the management account, with pooled usage for volume discounts and shared RIs and Savings Plans.
back.explanation: An unused RI in account A can discount a matching instance in account B.

cards.front: Do Service Control Policies (SCPs) in Organizations grant permissions?

back.answer: No. SCPs are permission ceilings defining the maximum an account's identities can do; they never grant.
back.explanation: A user still needs an IAM policy that allows the action.

cards.front: What is the effective permission when SCPs and IAM both apply in Organizations?

back.answer: SCP allows it AND IAM allows it. Either one denying means denied.

cards.front: Where can an Organizations SCP be attached?

back.answer: The Root, OUs, or individual accounts; it cascades down the tree.
back.explanation: Classic use is explicit-deny guardrails, e.g. block regions outside eu-west-1 or block disabling CloudTrail.

cards.front: Trap: Do SCPs apply to the Organizations management account?

back.answer: No. SCPs do NOT apply to the management account; it is exempt.
back.explanation: If a restriction must also bind the management account, an SCP alone can't do it. Best practice: keep workloads out of the management account.
back.mnemonic: The building owner is exempt from building rules.

cards.front: A user has AdministratorAccess in a member account but gets Access Denied. What should you check?

back.answer: The SCP on their account or OU.
back.explanation: Nothing is broken; the SCP ceiling overrides the IAM allow.

cards.front: What is AWS Control Tower relative to Organizations?

back.answer: An automated, opinionated setup on top of Organizations that builds a landing zone.
back.explanation: The landing zone is a pre-architected multi-account environment with logging, audit accounts, and SSO.

cards.front: What does Control Tower Account Factory do?

back.answer: Self-service creation of new, standardized, pre-configured accounts.

cards.front: How are Control Tower preventive guardrails implemented?

back.answer: As SCPs, which block disallowed actions.

cards.front: How are Control Tower detective guardrails implemented?

back.answer: As AWS Config rules, which detect and flag violations after the fact.

cards.front: Control Tower vs plain Organizations: when do you pick Control Tower?

back.answer: Control Tower for an automated, governed, best-practice multi-account environment; plain Organizations for just grouping accounts or billing.

cards.front: What does AWS RAM (Resource Access Manager) do?

back.answer: Shares resources across accounts without duplication: VPC subnets, Transit Gateways, Route 53 Resolver rules, License Manager configs.
back.explanation: Use it to avoid building the same networking in every account.

cards.front: Organizations: prevent all accounts in the organization from launching resources outside approved regions. What do you use?

back.answer: An SCP on the root/OU.
back.explanation: An org-wide ceiling is an SCP.

choices.why: Not centrally enforced; admins can change it.

choices.text: SCP on the root or OU

cards.front: An Organizations SCP denies an action, yet the management account can still perform it. Why?

back.answer: SCPs don't apply to the management account.

choices.text: SCPs don't apply to the management account

cards.front: New teams need self-service AWS accounts pre-configured with security baselines. Which service/feature?

back.answer: Control Tower Account Factory.

cards.front: A company wants a single bill and shared Reserved Instance discounts across accounts. What do they use?

back.answer: Organizations consolidated billing.

cards.front: Multiple accounts must use the same VPC subnets or a central Transit Gateway. What do you use?

back.answer: AWS RAM.

choices.why: Shares subnets and TGW across accounts.

cards.front: An IAM user has full admin policy in a member account but is denied. What do you check?

back.answer: The SCP.
back.explanation: The ceiling overrides the IAM allow.

choices.text: The SCP on the account or OU

cards.front: Automatically set up a multi-account environment following AWS best practices. What do you use?

back.answer: Control Tower.

cards.front: Control Tower guardrail that flags noncompliant resources but doesn't block creation: which type?

back.answer: Detective guardrail (Config rule).

cards.front: Keyword: **"Block actions org-wide / by OU"**

back.answer: SCP

cards.front: Keyword: **"SCP grants permissions?"**

back.answer: Never — ceiling only (needs IAM allow too)

cards.front: Keyword: **"SCP vs management account"**

back.answer: Doesn't apply — exempt

cards.front: Keyword: **"One bill, shared RI/SP discounts"**

back.answer: Consolidated billing

cards.front: Keyword: **"Automated governed multi-account setup"**

back.answer: Control Tower

cards.front: Keyword: **"Self-service standardized new accounts"**

back.answer: Account Factory

cards.front: Keyword: **"Preventive guardrail"**

back.answer: SCP (blocks)

cards.front: Keyword: **"Detective guardrail"**

back.answer: Config rule (flags)

cards.front: Keyword: **"Share subnets / TGW / resolver rules"**

back.answer: RAM

cards.front: Keyword: **"Admin denied in member account"**

back.answer: Check the SCP
